archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Gears of War: E-Day Goes Gold

entries.headline: Shape of Dreams Launches on Xbox Series X|S and Joins Game Pass
entries.summary: The co-op action roguelite launched for Xbox Series X|S on September 17 and joined Xbox Game Pass on day one, alongside its largest update, The Starless Path.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire developer post directly confirms the Xbox release, Game Pass availability, and simultaneous update.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day Goes Gold, With Pre-Load Starting September 29
entries.summary: The Coalition says the game has gone gold. Pre-load begins September 29 for Xbox Series X|S and PC, Premium Edition early access starts October 1, and the full launch follows October 6.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire post from The Coalition directly confirms gold status, pre-load, early access, and launch timing.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Hands-On Shows Vincent, Cid, and the FITS System
entries.summary: The Tokyo Game Show demo covered the Whirlwind Maze, Vincent and Cid’s combat styles, the FITS System, and a Jenova Deathmourner boss battle. The PS5 game is scheduled for April 8, 2027.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog hands-on report directly records the playable demo and the established release information.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Fountains Creator John Pywell Discusses Five Years of Solo Development
entries.summary: In an Xbox Wire interview, John Pywell looks back on five years of solo development and explains how Dark Souls’ interconnected world and Hollow Knight’s exploration loop shaped Fountains.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire article is a direct creator interview about development history and design influences.
entries.timeNote: The interview timestamp converts to Beijing time and falls inside the fixed window.
